metadata.title: Endpoint Configuration and Hardening

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enforcing preventive configuration and hardening controls that reduce endpoint attack surface and constrain execution.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint operating systems, firmware, configuration baselines, hardening policies, and execution control mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern defining preventive controls that harden endpoints against known classes of exploitation prior to runtime.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Configuration and hardening apply only to endpoints that satisfy Endpoint Core enrollment and trust requirements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint configuration and hardening align with NIST guidance for secure configuration, least functionality, and control baselining.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Operating system configuration and baselining guidance.

metadata.remarks: Endpoint Configuration and Hardening defines preventive, baseline controls that reduce endpoint exploitability and execution risk. This pattern enforces configuration discipline and attack surface reduction but does not evaluate posture, respond to active threats, or manage lifecycle state.

components.title: Secure Configuration Baseline
components.description: Requires endpoints to conform to an approved and versioned secure configuration baseline.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: System information discovery exploiting insecure or default configurations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Secure configuration baselines reduce exposure to known exploitation paths.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Baseline configurations are defined, documented, and maintained.

components.title: Attack Surface Reduction
components.description: Disables or constrains services, features, and interfaces not required for endpoint function.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Command and script execution via unnecessary interpreters or services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Attack surface reduction limits available execution paths.

implemented-requirements.remarks: The endpoint environment enforces least functionality.

components.title: Exploit Mitigation and Memory Protection
components.description: Applies operating system protections to limit memory corruption and exploit techniques.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Exploit mitigations reduce reliability of memory corruption attacks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Address space randomization and execution protections are enforced.

components.title: Privilege and Execution Hardening
components.description: Restricts administrative privilege and enforces controlled elevation and execution.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through misconfiguration or excess rights.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privilege hardening limits attacker lateral escalation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Endpoint enforces least privilege for users and processes.
